function.description: Wrap native gas currency into its ERC-20 form (ETH -> WETH) on this chain, 1:1. Use this when a venue needs an ERC-20 and the wallet holds only native. The destination is the chain registry's pinned wrapped native, never a supplied address. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_wrap

amount.description: Human amount of NATIVE to wrap (e.g. 0.0012 ETH -> 0.0012 WETH).

chain.description: Chain to wrap native on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and returns the guard's verdict without broadcasting. Set false to actually wrap.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD you authorize to leave the wallet, asserted against the SIMULATED native outflow.
